notice.title: Notice
notice.body: Kadal Mitra uses your location only to warn you near the border line and in bad weather, and to tell your family when you are back. Your voice notes are turned into text to answer you and are not stored. Questions you speak or type are sent to Sarvam AI and Google Gemini to answer them, without your name, phone or position. Your personal data is stored in Mumbai and deleted when you delete your account. You can withdraw consent at any time from Me. Grievance officer and contact: see Help.
